svg.title: Flow figure: Complete the delivery, Is it a delivery job?, Refused, May this user complete it?, Already completed?, Nothing written, Save in one transaction, Announce the delivery, Mark the order delivered, On error: log it, stop, Already posted?, Write the parcels out, Ledger miss logged, Delivery jobs, Delivery job events, Sales orders, Parcel moves. Steps: Delivered, Not a delivery job, Ledger write fails.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Complete the delivery, Is it a delivery job?, Refused, May this user complete it?, Already completed?, Nothing written, Save in one transaction, Announce the delivery, Mark the order delivered, On error: log it, stop, Already posted?, Write the parcels out, Ledger miss logged, Delivery jobs, Delivery job events, Sales orders, Parcel moves. Delivered. The driver taps complete. The API checks the job and the user. The API saves the job and a history row together. After the commit, the API announces the delivery in memory. The order listener marks the order delivered. The parcel ledger listener writes the parcels out. Not a delivery job. The job is not a delivery job. The API refuses. Ledger write fails. The API saves the completed job. The parcel ledger listener tries to write the parcels out. The write fails. The listener logs the error and stops.

g.text: The driver taps complete. The API checks the job and the user.
The API saves the job and a history row together.
After the commit, the API announces the delivery in memory.
The order listener marks the order delivered.
The parcel ledger listener writes the parcels out.
The job is not a delivery job. The API refuses.
The API saves the completed job.
The parcel ledger listener tries to write the parcels out.
The write fails. The listener logs the error and stops.
